performance.verdict: Money spending but zero CRM leads confirmed — intake gap, not ad failure.

findings.text: lead_drought flag: 28-day GHL leads = 0 despite 16 Google Ads conversions and 42 GBP calls. Intake pipe is broken, not the ads.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 — 17 days overdue. Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7; intake automation points at an empty seat.
GBP actions fell 51.61% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 14–16) show 5, 0, 0 — confirmed 3-day decline vs prior 3 days (5, 2, 0 avg still low).
Google spend is erratic — 10 of 28 days show $0 spend; 3-day signal (Aug 14–16): $14.11, $130.18, $9.12 — volatile, not pacing to ~$47/day target.
Meta spend = $0 across all 28 days and entire 45-day series. ~$600/mo Meta SOW budget is fully dark.

suggestions.text: Identify who owns intake after Vivian's 7/7 exit; confirm GHL login and after-hours coverage before any budget increase.
